integrity: All statements are confined to the specified graph and update rule; no authorship, independent audit, or historical novelty certification is asserted. Polynomial certificates are included in full and reproduced from the package.
scientific_limitations: Counts initially recurrent labelled majority configurations only, not attraction basins or transient times. Degree-two tie retention is required. The exact two-step transfer polynomial and golden leading coefficients are checked by full finite integer identities, but the conclusion has not received independent mathematical validation; absolute historical priority is uncertain. Published minority-rule fixed-state amplification already covers the same leading equilibrium coefficient and, by bipartite switching, the even-circumference majority fixed-state subcase.
title: Complementary golden-ratio responses to one missing rung in majority prisms
